records.clean_Japanese: 戦闘中は水夫編成できません！

records.clean_Japanese: エンディングデータをセーブしますか？
records.speaker: System
records.source_meaning: The game asks whether to save the ending data.
records.context: The original ending routine asks this after displaying the ending. Yes invokes the ending-data save; No skips it.
records.localization_note: Keep the direct Yes/No question and the distinction between ending data and ordinary saved progress. The DS prompt has no memory-card destination.

records.clean_Japanese: 洋上では船首像の変更はできません
records.current_English: At sea, you can't change figureheads.
records.speaker: System
records.english: You can't change figureheads at sea.
records.source_meaning: A ship's figurehead cannot be changed while at sea.
records.context: The equipment command is refused at sea before any figurehead swap.
records.localization_note: Put the condition after the action so the warning reads naturally. Figureheads stays consistent with the equipment interface.

records.english: This is exhibition data. If you quit, you'll lose it. Quit anyway?
records.source_meaning: This is fair or exhibition data. Suspending the game will lose it, and the player must confirm.
records.context: The source describes a special data type and data-loss confirmation. Its relationship to the active DS Quit prompt remains unproven.
records.localization_note: Make the consequence and choice explicit and replace the full-width I. Keep exhibition data as the provisional source term until its mode is bound.

records.localization_note: Use the normal American English article. The ordinary quit prompt carries no claim about saving or special exhibition data.

records.speaker: System

records.localization_note: Use an open question directed at the player. The two old leading spaces are handled by the chooser layout review.

records.speaker: System

records.speaker: System
